environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate with task role 'CommentServiceTaskRole'. The IAM policy uses DynamoDB fine-grained access control with leading key condition: dynamodb:LeadingKeys restricts PutItem to items where project_id matches a tag-based prefix derived from the ECS task's resource tag 'AllowedProjectPrefix' (set to 'internal-'). Additionally, a DynamoDB condition expression requires that the 'source' attribute equals 'web' for all PutItem operations via an IAM policy condition key dynamodb:Attributes with ForAllValues:StringEquals. The /cli/import endpoint writes items with source='cli', which will be DENIED by the IAM condition. A VPC endpoint policy for DynamoDB further restricts the dynamodb:PutItem action to requests where the item's partition key starts with 'internal-' prefix only. Comments from external sources that could contain XSS payloads cannot be persisted because the CLI import path sets source='cli' which violates the IAM attribute-level condition.

config.network: Private subnet, VPC endpoint for DynamoDB, no public ingress to /cli/import
